boards.name: Day in the life
boards.description: Build a visual timeline of a customer’s day — activities, moods, touchpoints and photos — on a clock-time ruler, from research.

cards.title: A day in the life — Maya (subscription customer)
cards.body: Reconstructed from a diary study and an interview. The ruler reads as clock time from 06:00 to 23:00.

cards.title: How to use this template
cards.body: Each moment is a card with what she does, feels and touches. Rose = friction, sage = delight. Opportunities go in the bottom row, linked to the moment that inspired them.

cards.title: 06:45 — the ritual
cards.body: Photo: Coffee Pour Over Setup — Cerebral726. CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

cards.title: 06:45 — brewing
cards.body: Grinds, pours, no phone. The best 20 minutes of her day.

cards.title: 08:00 — commute
cards.body: Photo: Most of the commuters are absorbed by their cell phones in a Taipei Metro train — ThomasYehYeh. CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

cards.title: 08:00 — commute
cards.body: Sees a “your coffee ships tomorrow” email. Panics: she’s away this weekend.

cards.title: 09:00 — work
cards.body: Photo: Laptop and a mug (Unsplash) — Ryan Riggins ryan_riggins. CC0, via Wikimedia Commons.

cards.title: 13:00 — tries to pause
cards.body: Photo: Woman sitting in cafe enjoying coffee and using smartphone while laptop rests on table — Shixart1985. CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

cards.title: 13:00 — tries to pause
cards.body: Can’t find pause. Emails support. Considers cancelling.

cards.title: 18:30 — café
cards.body: Photo: HK SYP 西營盤 Sai Ying Pun 正街 Centre Street First Street shops A1-Bakery Cafe evening March 2020 SS2 08 — Dunmfei Lihonm Aee. CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

cards.title: 18:30 — café
cards.body: Barista pauses it for her on the till. Relief.

cards.title: 21:30 — evening
cards.body: Photo: Senior couple sitting on sofa and reading a book in living closeup — Shixart1985. CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

cards.title: 21:30 — evening
cards.body: Orders a bag for a friend as a thank-you gift.

cards.title: Pause from the email
cards.body: One-tap pause link in the shipping email.

cards.title: Café as service desk
cards.body: Train baristas on subscriptions; give them a tablet.

cards.title: Gift moment
cards.body: “Send a bag to a friend” after a positive moment.
